test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.

Sometimes we interact to people who are closed-minded and not willing to listen.
solution:
The correct answer is **"to people who are closed-minded".**
